requirements.quote:

requirements.condition: When the destination is a loopback address.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may prevent connection attempts to that address.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can attempt a new connection to a loopback address and observe whether the endpoint blocks it.

requirements.quote:
authentication.  Endpoints MAY prevent connection attempts or
   migration to a loopback address.  Endpoints SHOULD NOT allow
requirements.condition: When migration would change the peer address to a loopback address.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may prevent the migration.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can initiate migration to a loopback address and observe whether the endpoint blocks it.

requirements.quote:

   connections or migration to a loopback address if the same service
   was previously available at a different interface or if the address
   was provided by a service at a non-loopback address.  Endpoints that
requirements.condition: The same service was previously available at a different interface.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint should not allow a connection or migration to a loopback address.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can establish prior availability on another interface and then verify that connection or migration to loopback is rejected.

requirements.quote:
migration to a loopback address.  Endpoints SHOULD NOT allow
   connections or migration to a loopback address if the same service
   was previously available at a different interface or if the address
   was provided by a service at a non-loopback address.  Endpoints that
requirements.condition: The loopback address was provided by a service at a non-loopback address.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint should not allow a connection or migration to that loopback address.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can have a non-loopback service supply a loopback address and verify that the endpoint rejects connection or migration to it.

requirements.quote:
interfering with legitimate uses.  Endpoints SHOULD NOT refuse to use
   an address unless they have specific knowledge about the network
   indicating that sending datagrams to unvalidated addresses in a given
   range is not safe.
requirements.condition: The endpoint lacks specific network knowledge indicating that sending datagrams to unvalidated addresses in the address's range is unsafe.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint should permit use of the address.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint should not refuse to use the address solely because it is in the considered address range.
requirements.why_checkable: Tests can configure the endpoint without the specified network knowledge and verify whether it refuses an otherwise usable address.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints MAY choose to reduce the risk of request forgery by not
   including values from NEW_TOKEN frames in Initial packets or by only
   sending probing frames in packets prior to completing address
   validation.  Note that this does not prevent an attacker from using
requirements.condition: When constructing Initial packets as a request-forgery countermeasure.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint may omit values obtained from NEW_TOKEN frames from Initial packets.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet inspection can determine whether Initial packets contain values derived from NEW_TOKEN frames.

requirements.quote:
Endpoints MAY choose to reduce the risk of request forgery by not
   including values from NEW_TOKEN frames in Initial packets or by only
   sending probing frames in packets prior to completing address
   validation.  Note that this does not prevent an attacker from using
requirements.condition: Before address validation has completed, when this request-forgery countermeasure is selected.
requirements.required_behavior: The endpoint may send only probing frames in packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The endpoint does not send non-probing frames in packets before completing address validation.
requirements.why_checkable: Captured packets sent before validation completes can be inspected to verify that every included frame is probing.
